roster.contributionFacilitator: Keep the pace and discuss the evidence. You start the timer and rotate the driver.

join.hint.createAuthed: You are signed in. Name your squad and create the room.
join.hint.createGoogle: Facilitators start here. Prefer Google sign-in; the start key is an emergency path only.
join.hint.createKey: Facilitators only. Enter the start key to create a squad.
join.hint.join: Enter your name and your facilitator's room code. No Google account needed.
join.googleLede: Sign in with your Google work account to start as facilitator.
join.hostKeyPlaceholder: Only if Google does not work
join.sideHint: Are you a facilitator? Choose I am a facilitator above and sign in with Google.
join.noApiKey: No Anthropic API key needed. Use your own signed-in Claude Code.
join.err.hostKey: That start key is incorrect. Check it or sign in with Google.
join.err.room: I do not recognise that room code. Ask your facilitator for the right one.
join.err.full: This squad is full. Ask your facilitator for another room.
join.err.duplicate: That name already exists in this room. Use the personal link you saved earlier, or ask your facilitator for help.
join.err.accessInvalid: This personal link no longer works. Ask your facilitator for help.
access.title: Your personal access link
access.help: Save this link. It brings you back to the same lessons and progress later.
access.copiedStatus: Your personal access link was copied.
join.path.label: How are you joining?
join.hint.cohort: Enter your personal cohort code. Your name and progress are ready; you land in today's room.
join.cohortCodeHelp: 16 characters. Dashes and capitals do not matter.
join.err.cohortInvalid: This cohort code does not work. Check the characters or ask your facilitator for a new code.
join.err.cohortExpired: Your access to this cohort has expired.
join.err.cohortNoRoom: Your cohort has no room for today yet. Ask your facilitator to attach the room.
join.err.cohortRate: Too many attempts. Wait a moment and try again.
join.err.cohortRoom: This room belongs to a cohort. Choose Cohort code and sign in with your personal code.
access.cohort: You sign in with your personal cohort code. Use the same code on another device.
readOnly.title: Read-only
readOnly.help: Your cohort's writing period has ended. You can still view and export your work.
cohort.title: Wave cohorts
cohort.name: Cohort name
cohort.codesHelp: Give each participant only their own code, in person. We keep only a hash; replace a lost code with New code.
join.login.domain: This Google account is not on an allowed work domain. Use your AetherLink or school account, or ask an admin.

doc.title: Our intent
doc.subtitle: One continuous document for the whole team.
doc.footDriver: Driver edits · navigators read and give feedback
doc.footAll: All squad members can collaborate in this document.
doc.opened: Editor open · sync not yet confirmed
knowledge.empty: No lesson found. Try a broader term.
coach.title: Ask your learning coach
coach.lede: The mission, your squad intent and all lessons as context. Explanation at your level, with sources you can find again.
coach.noMcp: No successful MCP call registered yet
coach.mcpNote: The game does not start an agent and does not use a model API. An MCP call only confirms transport, not which account or model used the tool.
coach.needParticipantBody: Open the session as a participant to copy personal Claude instructions. The facilitator has no participant access of their own.
coach.copyBlocked: Copying is blocked. Select the instructions below and press ⌘C or Ctrl+C.
coach.instructionsLabel: Claude instructions (private, only for your Claude)
coach.privateNote: Instructions apply only to this session and expire automatically. Keep them private.
coach.pasteTitle: Paste into your own Claude Code
coach.pasteBody: Claude handles the link and confirms your name and squad. You do not need to enter a key or configuration yourself.
copy.selected: Text selected. Press ⌘C (Mac) or Ctrl+C to copy.
copy.done: Copy command ran. If paste fails, use Select configuration and ⌘C or Ctrl+C.
copy.fallback: Automatic copy is unavailable in this browser. The text is selected; press ⌘C (Mac) or Ctrl+C.
lesson.noneHint: Pick another day when it is ready, or ask your facilitator to switch the day.
lesson.quizHint: Private help choice. The facilitator sees your score; your squad does not see a leaderboard.
lesson.soloHint: You can always choose more help on the solo mission.
solo.noneHint: Pick another day when it is ready, or ask your facilitator to switch the day.
solo.helpAmount: How much help do you want?
solo.hintFallback: Compare the starter files with the instructions and note what you actually observe.
solo.stretchFallback: Make your check repeatable for a fresh reader without extra access.
solo.workspaceHint: Use your own copy of starter/. Fiction only; no client systems needed.
solo.submitHint: Also available via MCP tool submit_evidence. Your contribution appears as a Proof comment; it is not yet an accepted conclusion.
solo.sent: Evidence added to Proof and the squad review.
review.title: Ready for handoff?
review.lede: Judge what was actually demonstrated. Ask a fresh reader to repeat the check.
review.emptyCriteria: Use the criteria above when your squad submits evidence.
review.emptyDefault: Solo missions and MCP contributions land here.
review.handoffSaved: Handoff recorded in Proof. The facilitator rotates the driver separately.
suggestions.title: Document suggestions
suggestions.empty: No suggestions yet. Your Claude Code can propose a grounded change via MCP.
reflection.title: My reflection · day {day}
reflection.privacy: You and your facilitator can read this reflection; your squad cannot.
route.title: Five days. Real progress.
route.lede: From starting together to applying independently. Step by step, with your squad and learning coach.
route.preface: Beforehand: 2 classroom sessions on agent productivity and adapting your workflow. Chips show your quiz, help choice, evidence, review, handoff and reflection per day.
debrief.title: {name} · day {day}
debrief.lede: Progress for the current day. The facilitator can read personal reflections; squad members only see status chips.
decks.title: Slide decks
decks.lede: Build a deck together with your own Claude Code, review it as a squad and present it full-screen. Every deck belongs to this squad room only.
decks.newPlaceholder: Deck title, e.g. Sprint recap week 3
decks.agentTitle: Let your Claude build the slides
decks.agentBody: Your connected Claude Code has the tools create_deck, add_slide, update_slide, patch_deck and export_deck_html. Ask it for a deck; the slides appear here while it works.
decks.empty: No decks yet. Create one here or ask your Claude for a deck.
decks.deleteConfirm: Delete deck "{title}"? This cannot be undone.
decks.noSlides: This deck has no slides yet. Add one or ask your Claude to add slides.
decks.editHint: Slide id {id} in deck {deckId}. Your Claude edits it with update_slide; use the contentHash from get_deck.
decks.newSlideBody: Replace this text or let your Claude write it.

lab.heading: Lab
lab.preview: Facilitator preview: completing it here is not recorded.
board.title: Debrief board
board.lede: Write a card per column. Everyone in the room sees new cards live.
board.closedLede: The facilitator closed the board. You can still read it, but no longer edit it.
board.none: No debrief board for this room yet.
board.emptyFacilitator: Open the board at the start of the debrief. Participants then see it in their menu.
board.emptyParticipant: The facilitator has not opened the debrief board yet.
board.footOpen: Cards are shared live through this board's Proof document.
board.footClosed: Read-only. The facilitator can reopen or export the board.
board.columnsPlaceholder: Column names are a provisional choice.
tasks.title: Today's tasks
tasks.lede: Submit evidence per task. Another participant or the facilitator reviews it and you see the feedback here.
tasks.empty: No tasks for this day yet.
queue.title: Review queue ({count})
queue.lede: Submitted tasks wait for your decision. Your decision is added to the evidence as a Proof comment.
peer.lede: Submitted tasks from other participants in your room, for today. Your decision is added to the evidence as a Proof comment.
peer.title: To review ({count})
chat.title: Ask the Academy
chat.lede: Navigation and FAQ from today’s day pack. No AI: ask your own Claude for deeper help.
chat.promptLabel: Paste this question into your own Claude:
chat.label: Your question
chat.placeholder: E.g. where do I find my assignment?
chat.offForParticipants: Off for participants. Only you see this chat.
autograde.lede: Pick the label your agent gave for each fixture ticket. The server compares them with the expected labels; you never see those, only whether each label is right.
autograde.result: {score}/{total} labels right · attempt {attempts}. Fix your agent, not the labels.
course.title: Compose the course
course.lede: A course is an ordered set of day packs. Choose which days take part, in which order, with their own title and date. Each pack's content stays in git.
course.none: This room follows the fixed 7-day order.
course.name: Course name
course.sot: Only order, selection, titles and dates can be changed per course. Lesson content is changed at the source.
